definitions.explanation: A personal shopping bag brought from home instead of using disposable plastic bags, promoted as an eco-friendly practice.

examples.japanese: マイバッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧きた。
マイバッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I forgot my reusable bag and had to buy one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧マイバッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く→持ち歩く：05739_mochiaruku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Recently, many people carry reusable bags with them.

notes:
マイバッグ became much more common after Japan started charging for plastic bags (⟦レジ{袋|ぶくろ}→レジ袋：09531_rejibukuro⟧{有料化|ゆうりょうか}) in July 2020. Many people now carry foldable bags in their purses or pockets.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- マイバッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持参|じさん}する→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧ (to bring one's own bag)
- マイバッグ⟦{持参|じさん}→持参：00127_jisan⟧ (bring your own bag)
- ⟦{折|お}りたたみ→折りたたみ：11332_oritatami⟧マイバッグ (foldable reusable bag)
